explanation: The statement is about the library's own TailEquiv.pieceEquiv, an AddEquiv between Veronese pieces 𝒜 (n*i) and ℬ (n*i). It says the inverse is compatible with the graded multiplication GMul. The content comes from the library's field piece_mul. The proof uses injectivity and the apply_symm_apply lemma on top of piece_mul. Mathlib has no lemma about this structure. I did not run any searches. I judged this from the statement and proof alone. Generic Mathlib lemmas such as map_mul on MulEquiv.symm don't apply, because pieceEquiv is only an AddEquiv with multiplicativity given as a separate hypothesis.
